en.headline: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory musical opens in Hong Kong in November
en.dek: The Broadway production of Roald Dahl’s story, starring Daniel Plimpton as Willy Wonka, begins its Hong Kong run next month with an extended engagement.
body: The musical adaptation of Roald Dahl’s Charlie and the Chocolate Factory is set to open in Hong Kong in November.

Organisers said the production, which premiered in the West End in 2013 and on Broadway in 2017, features stagecraft by Las Vegas illusionist Tim Clothier. In the Hong Kong shows Daniel Plimpton plays Willy Wonka and Oliver Wong plays Charlie.
The local run has been extended through 6 December. The Peninsula Hong Kong is listed as the official hotel partner and is offering themed packages tied to the performances.
Tickets and further details are available through the production’s official channels.

zh.headline: 《查理與巧克力工廠》音樂劇十一月在港上演
zh.dek: 百老匯製作改編羅爾德·達爾故事，由Daniel Plimpton飾演威利·旺卡，香港演出期已延長至十二月六日。
body: 改編自羅爾德·達爾小說的音樂劇《查理與巧克力工廠》將於十一月在香港開演。
主辦方表示，該劇於2013年在倫敦西區首演，2017年登上百老匯，舞台效果由拉斯維加斯魔術師Tim Clothier操刀。香港場次由Daniel Plimpton飾演威利·旺卡，Oliver Wong飾演查理。
本地演出期已延長至十二月六日。半島酒店為官方酒店合作夥伴，並提供與演出相關的主題套餐。
詳情及門票可透過製作官方渠道查詢。
